action.description: check=run mypy; classify=parse raw output; fix=apply automated fixes; baseline=update .mypy_baseline; report=summary by file/pattern

mypy_output.description: Raw mypy stdout (for 'classify' action — skips running mypy)

src_dir.description: Path to source directory (relative to repo root)

baseline_file.description: Path to baseline file (relative to repo root)

fix_patterns.description: Which fix patterns to apply (for 'fix' action). Empty = apply all safe patterns.

dry_run.description: If true, show what would be fixed without writing files

pda_log.description: Whether to append patterns to PDA Loop .jsonl store

session.description: Session ID for PDA Loop entries (e.g. 'S285')
